What is the verse from which this is derived? It is derived from: “She is a man’s wife”
with the ascension [aliya] of her husband but does not … with the descent of her husband.
with the ascension [aliya] of her husband but does not descend with the descent of her husband.
“As she was the mother of all living” … she was given … for living … but was not given to … pain
“As she was the mother of all living” (Genesis 3:20), which indicates that she was given to her husband for living with him, but was not given to suffer pain
